errors.evidence: The description describes the chart's purpose using information from the paper's caption ("reading comprehension accuracy"), which is not present in the image itself. The chart's visible title is "单词乱序数据" (Scrambled word data).
The description interprets the x-axis as "response accuracy", which is information from the external caption, not from the image itself, as the x-axis has no label.
The description interprets the y-axis as "number of questions", which is information from the external caption, not from the image itself, as the y-axis has no label.
The description states that the bars are gray ("灰色"), but they are blue in the image.
